title: BabidiGhost: An AI-Augmented Cybercrime Operation
content_md: New research by SOCRadar Research Team has revealed BabidiGhost, a French-speaking operator who spent nine days in November 2026 targeting European banks, insurers, payment providers and municipalities through a jailbroken AI agent. The operator wrote his orders in plain, misspelled French and left the technical work to the agent. One order, translated, reads: “Make me 13 files of 1,000 full records with IBAN, nice and tidy.” The operator’s staging server exposed his home directory to the internet: the agent’s identity file, every prompt he typed, his shell history, a Telegram bot token, implant logs and about 10 GB of stolen data. SOCRadar recovered that directory and reconstructed the operation end to end. BabidiGhost is the second operator SOCRadar has documented using this toolchain. Part I of this series, Discernment Deleted: Inside the Operation Server of BlackHatSect0r && DXQRTXX , published on September 16, 2026, covered the skilled BlackHatSect0r crew that stripped an AI agent of its refusals. BabidiGhost uses the same agent and the same jailbreak but has far less technical skill. BabidiGhost at a glance: nine days of AI-run activity recovered from one exposed server.
